name: clarify_release_chairs
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. A team wants ergonomic chairs from SeatWorks, delivered in three instalments. The total commitment has not been provided and no order has been placed. What do you need before identifying our approval route?
ground_truth: Ask for the total commitment across all instalments, not a per-invoice amount. Do not enumerate the alternative spending routes while the total is missing or treat instalments as separate purchases. Ordinary chairs need no software or training approvals. Source: [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_release_renewal
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. Our DesignCloud Studio renewal is $7,300. We have two quotations and Category Manager approval. The renewal's intended use and data scope have not been supplied. What is the next step?
ground_truth: Ask for intended use and data scope to establish whether current security clearance covers the renewal. Do not assume public-only use, enumerate hypothetical approval branches or request the completed quotations and spending approval again. Sources: [policy:software-review] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_release_nova_group
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We need $8,100 of Nova Learning Portal licences. We will use only public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records. I haven't said which programme or employee group they are for. No individual approval has been obtained. What information do you need next?
ground_truth: Ask which programme or employee group the training is for, without presenting competing graduate and normal spending routes. The amount and data scope are known and should not be requested again. Current portal security clearance covers this scope; training suitability approval is independently required and may be mentioned. Sources: [policy:training-suitability] [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance].

name: remaining_release_second_quote
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. An ordinary printer purchase totals $9,200 with no separate software service. Category Manager spending approval is already obtained, but we have only one supplier quotation. What remains before ordering?
ground_truth: Obtain a second supplier quotation before commitment. Category Manager spending approval is complete and must not be requested again. Do not add line-manager approval, software review or training approval. Source: [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_release_clearance_expired
query: Decision date: 2027-01-01. We have one quotation and line-manager approval for a $2,300 DesignCloud Studio renewal using only public templates, already-public marketing assets and business-email login. We have no security clearance other than the notice ending December 31, 2026. What remains?
ground_truth: Obtain current Security Team clearance before renewal. The public-assets notice expired December 31, 2026 inclusive, even though the data scope matches. Spending prerequisites are already complete and must not be requested again. Sources: [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:software-review] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_release_brightpath_small
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. Our $3,400 BrightPath in-person Leadership Essentials workshop is for new people managers, with no online service. We have one quotation and Training Lead approval but no spending approval. What must happen before booking?
ground_truth: Obtain line-manager spending approval before commitment. The BrightPath exception has expired and the normal route for $3,400 applies. Do not ask for Head of Learning or Category Manager approval, another quotation, repeated Training Lead approval or software review. Sources: [notice:brightpath-leadership-exception] [policy:purchasing] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:software-review].

name: exception_release_last_day
query: Decision date: 2026-11-04. We want $11,300 of Nova Learning Portal licences for the new graduate programme. We have one quotation and Training Lead approval, but no spending approval. We will use only public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records. Which approval do we need now?
ground_truth: Obtain Head of Learning spending approval today, November 4, 2026 inclusive, before commitment. The graduate exception is still valid today despite approval not yet being obtained. The quotation and suitability approval are complete, and portal security clearance covers this use. Do not require a second quotation or Category Manager approval. Sources: [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability].

name: exception_release_day_after
query: Decision date: 2026-11-05. We want $8,600 of Nova Learning Portal licences for the new graduate programme. We have one quotation and Training Lead approval, but no spending approval. Use is only public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records. What remains before purchase?
ground_truth: Obtain a second supplier quotation and Category Manager spending approval before commitment. The graduate exception ended November 4 inclusive and cannot be used today. Training Lead approval is complete, and the portal security clearance still covers the use through December 31 inclusive. Sources: [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [policy:purchasing] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability].

name: exception_release_small_quote_missing
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have Head of Learning spending approval and Training Lead approval for $950 of Nova Learning Portal licences for the new graduate programme. We have no supplier quotation. Use is limited to public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records. What is still missing?
ground_truth: Obtain one supplier quotation before commitment. The graduate exception applies regardless of the small amount, and spending/suitability approvals are already complete. Do not additionally require line-manager approval or fresh security review; the portal clearance covers the stated use. Sources: [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability].

name: ready_release_large_hardware
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have two supplier quotations and Category Manager spending approval for $14,200 of ordinary desks, with no software or training included. Is any purchasing requirement still outstanding?
ground_truth: No additional requirement is identified under the supplied policies. The two quotations and Category Manager approval satisfy the route above $5,000. Do not add line-manager approval, security review or training approval, or claim to grant approval personally. Source: [policy:purchasing].

name: ready_release_clearance_last_day
query: Decision date: 2026-12-31. We have two quotations and Category Manager approval for $7,900 of DesignCloud Studio. We will use only public templates, already-public marketing assets and business-email login. No other data is involved. Can we purchase today under these policies?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified for purchase today. The public-assets clearance remains valid through December 31, 2026 inclusive and covers the stated scope; quotations and spending approval are complete. Do not require a new security review for today's purchase or repeat completed spending steps. Sources: [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:purchasing] [policy:software-review].

name: ready_release_nova_leadership
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have two quotations, Category Manager spending approval and Training Lead approval for $10,400 of Nova Learning Portal leadership-training licences. We will use public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records only. Can we proceed?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified under the supplied policies. The normal spending route is complete; the graduate exception is irrelevant to leadership training. Training suitability is complete and current portal security clearance covers leadership within this scope. Do not require Head of Learning approval or a fresh security review. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:training-suitability] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [notice:nova-graduate-exception].
